description: This file defines the interface 'PromiseInterface' for asynchronous promise operations in the GuzzleHttp Promise library. It specifies methods for handling promise states, resolution, rejection, cancellation, and waiting behavior.

classes.name: PromiseInterface
classes.description: An interface representing a promise for an asynchronous operation, with methods for managing its lifecycle and state.

methods.name: then
methods.description: Registers fulfillment and rejection handlers, returning a new promise.

methods.name: otherwise
methods.description: Registers a rejection handler, returning a new promise.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Returns the current state of the promise ('pending', 'fulfilled', or 'rejected').

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves the promise with a given value.

methods.name: reject
methods.description: Rejects the promise with a specified reason.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Attempts to cancel the promise, if possible.

methods.name: wait
methods.description: Waits for the promise to complete, optionally unwrapping the result or exception.
